messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: N_TESTS
parts:
Can we make the N_TESTS constant in $STAN_HOME/src/test/unit-distribution/generate_tests configurable at run time (besides just manually changing it before compiling)? My understanding is that N_TESTS is set to 75 because g++-4.6 on Windows cannot compile much more than that at one time. But if you are using clang++, you can easily go a lot higher than that. The exception is the beta_binomial tests, which seem to eat up a lot more RAM than the other distributions, even though there are not so many combinations of arguments because two of them have to be integers. Maybe it is the F32 stuff? Anyway, I can only set N_TESTS to 200 to compile the beta_binomial tests in parallel with 8 cores and 16 GB of RAM. Most of the other distributions use about 1GB of RAM per process.

Ben
